args.subject: Group Booking Availability – 10 People, June 2024
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am Emma Johnson from Blue Sparrow Tech, and I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo.

We would like to enquire about availability for a group of 10 people in June 2024. Could you please let us know:

- Whether you have room for a group of 10 for the dates we are considering
- The group rates or any discounted pricing available for bookings of this size
- Whether there are any minimum stay requirements or deadlines for securing a group rate
- What information you need from us in order to hold or confirm a booking

We would be happy to provide further details on our preferred dates and room requirements once you confirm what is available.

Thank you for your assistance, and we look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
